audit_treatment.reason: The two raw mismatches are retained as evidence but count as caveated passes under the accepted historical adjudication.

expected_backend_behavior: After close, pin reads to an explicit block at or after SubmissionClosed and verify the RPC provider has reached it.
Retry every final on-chain CID and fail or defer finalization explicitly when content is unavailable.
Never silently convert a missing or unavailable submission into a zero score or reward.
observations: Polygon accepted both final CIDs before SubmissionClosed.
Both archives now pass CID, decryption, originator, schema, symbol, and numeric validation.
This address was the last submitter in both competitions and the only valid challenge-8 submission published as zero.
The same address used the same headerless CSV structure in challenges 9 and 10 and was scored exactly there.

working_hypotheses.explanation: The backend captured or processed its submission set before final on-chain close state.
The backend read from an RPC or indexer that had not synchronized through the close block.
The CIDs were temporarily unavailable through the backend's IPFS peers or gateway.

documentation.summary: The early backend likely captured submissions before the final on-chain close state, read from a lagging RPC, or encountered late IPFS availability; the two raw mismatches are accepted as caveated historical exceptions.

problems.headline: Challenge 8: Late submissions likely omitted by an early or stale backend snapshot
